positions.title: Freelance Animator & Designer
positions.description:
I work with a variety of mediums to meet clients' requests, working closely with them throughout the process to guarantee satisfaction. 
Projects have included installation sculptures for Las Culturas Gallery in MA, generating graphics and animations for Build It Yourself, Pearl Arts and Crafts, and individual commissions.
I also design and sew a variety of fabric crafts including pillows, heating pads, and small plush dolls on Etsy.

Some of my more recent design work has involved creating animated visual aids for course material that is presented both online and in the classroom. Specifically, the animated material used in the "flipped" course was overwhelming successful and has generated more interest in creative visual aids for STEM courses. 

Please view my online portfolio here
http://jasminecarter.squarespace.com

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Responsible for the written and visual communication for the Mechanical Engineering Department and disseminating information through internal and external channels. This includes but is not limited to creating printed and digital promotional material for events, designing web banners and buttons, and managing and growing the Department's new social media platforms. 

Maintain and update the current website for the Mechanical Engineering Department. 

Collaborate with faculty to create academic lecture material for new online-learning platform. Currently developing a strategy to improve current production quality of online flipped lecture videos, including video editing using Adobe Creative Cloud. Work with faculty to create animated visual aids for conceptual lecture material.

positions.title: Undergraduate Coordinator
positions.description:
Create and edit conflict-free course scheduling solutions for the College of Engineering Mechanical Engineering students for fall and spring semesters.

Provide guidance to Mechanical Engineering based student groups in regards to their funding, including writing funding request letters to the Dean, negotiating on the Department and College level for funding, and assisting in event organization.

Organize and execute various department events to encourage undergraduate involvement in the department and to increase interest in freshmen and sophomore students who may not know which department in Engineering that they would like to focus. 

Coordinate with several professors and admin to run the senior year thesis presentations, including reserving rooms, ordering catering, organizing luncheons and collaborating with IT contacts to make sure the event runs smoothly.

positions.title: Administrative Secretary
positions.locationName: College of Engineering- Office of the Dean
positions.description:
Responsible for creating a smooth running office environment. This entailed ordering office supplies and catering. I also served as the main point of contact for incoming calls to the office, emails, and visitors. 
Maintained several calendars for the associate deans in the office, while offering support to the Executive Secretary of the Dean of the College of Engineering.
